root_causes_and_resolutions.symptom: After all worktrees were removed, 28 local branches classified as unique commits or patches.
root_causes_and_resolutions.confirmed_root_cause: The inspection-only classifier intentionally treats commit/patch ancestry as a hold; multi-commit squash integration can remain patch-unique even when the complete PR-head tree exactly equals the merged reachable tree.
root_causes_and_resolutions.resolution: Resume only after rechecking the exact local/remote heads and accepting the already audited PR-head/merge-tree equality for those named branches.
root_causes_and_resolutions.proof: classifier_after_worktree_removal.exact_tree_boundary_acceptances binds each exception to its PR, branch tree, merge commit, equal merge tree, and current-main reachability.
